p: hold my peace: The prophet says that he will never cease to declare to the people the good tidings of their deliverance.
brightness: Till they have full deliverance: and this the prophet speaks to encourage all other ministers to the setting forth of God's mercies toward his Church.
a new name: You will have a more excellent fame than you have had till now.
crown of glory in the hand: He will value you as dear and precious as a king does his crown.
Forsaken: You will no longer be contemned as a woman forsaken by her husband.
married: That it may be replenished with children.

marry thee: As they confess one faith and religion with you, they are in the same bond of marriage with you, and they are called the children of the Church, as Christ makes her plentiful to bring forth children to him.
watchmen upon thy walls: Prophets, pastors and ministers.
ye that make mention of the: He exhorts the ministers never to cease to call on God by prayer for the deliverance of his Church and to teach others to do the same.
praise in the earth: For the restoration of which all the world will praise him.
Go through: Signifying the great number that would come to the Church, and what means he would prepare for the restitution of the same, as in Isa 57:14.
Say ye to the daughter of: You prophets and ministers show the people of this their deliverance: which was chiefly meant of our salvation by Christ, Zec 9:9, Mt 21:5.
his work before him: He will have all power to bring his purpose to pass, as in Isa 40:10.
city not forsaken: That is, one over whom God has had a singular care to recover her when she was lost.
